# Template: pk_curve
A pharmacokinetic plasma-concentration-versus-time curve: a single oral dose (the rise-and-fall Bateman curve), an IV bolus (instant peak, then exponential decay with optional half-life staircase guides), or repeated dosing (the accumulating sawtooth that levels off at steady state after about five half-lives, with a dashed steady-state line), plus an optional shaded therapeutic window band and a loading-dose comparison. Choose this scene for ANY request about pharmacokinetics, drug concentration or plasma levels over time, half-life, drug elimination or clearance decay, repeated dosing and steady state, therapeutic windows, or loading doses.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "route": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "oral",
    "iv"
   ],
   "description": "oral = absorption rise then decay (default); iv = instant peak then pure exponential decay."
  },
  "half_life": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Elimination half-life in hours, 0.5-48 (default 6)."
  },
  "doses": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "Number of doses, 1-60 (default 1); doses past t_max are not drawn. 4+ doses in view draw the steady-state line."
  },
  "dose_interval": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Hours between doses, 1-48 (default 12). Only used when doses > 1."
  },
  "dose": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Size of each dose, 0.05-5 (default 1 = a dose that peaks at 1.0 on its own). Same daily amount, split: {dose: 1, dose_interval: 24} → animate {dose: 0.25, dose_interval: 6} — set t_max, y_max and enough doses to fill t_max so nothing but the curve moves."
  },
  "loading_dose": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Multiplier for the FIRST dose, 1-3 (default 1). E.g. 2 = double loading dose that jumps straight toward the plateau."
  },
  "y_max": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Fixed top of the concentration axis, in the window's units (default: 1.12 × the highest peak or window edge; a y_max below that gives way). Set it, above every peak the animate reaches, when animating dose, dose_interval or loading_dose — else the axis rescales every frame and the band seems to move."
  },
  "show_average": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Dashed \"Average\" line at the steady-state average level, dose ÷ interval × the area under one dose (default false; repeated doses only). The same daily amount gives the same average, however it is split."
  },
  "show_window": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Shaded therapeutic window band (default false)."
  },
  "window_low": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Lower edge of the window in concentration units where a single regular dose peaks at 1.0 (default 1.0)."
  },
  "window_high": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Upper edge of the window (default 2.5)."
  },
  "show_half_lives": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Dashed half-life staircase guides at t½, 2t½, 3t½ (default true for a single IV dose, else false)."
  },
  "t_max": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Hours shown (default: 5 half-lives for a single dose, doses+1.5 intervals for repeated)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with axis captions and tick numbers: time in hours, in days once t_max passes 96)
- curve: the concentration curve itself
- dose_<i>: small arrow on the time axis marking when dose i is taken
- window: the therapeutic window (shaded band + dashed edges, a group; its caption window__t comes with it)
- ss_line: dashed line at the steady-state PEAK — the highest the sawtooth rises once it has levelled off (4+ doses in view)
- label_ss: "Steady-state peak" caption on that line (drawn with it)
- avg_line: dashed line at the steady-state average level (show_average)
- label_avg: "Average" caption on that line (drawn with it)
- half_guides: the half-life staircase guides (a group, single IV dose)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Show how a drug is eliminated after an IV dose." → params: {"route":"iv","title":"Exponential elimination"}
Request: "Show repeated dosing building up to steady state." → params: {"doses":6,"dose_interval":12,"show_window":true,"title":"Reaching steady state"}
Request: "One pill a day, or a quarter of it every six hours?" → params: {"doses":20,"dose_interval":24,"dose":1,"half_life":12,"t_max":120,"y_max":2.6,"show_average":true}

In YAML: `template: pk_curve` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
